completion_decisions: Use paper Eqs. (1)-(6) and (11)-(17) for the yawed three-dimensional Gaussian wake, local-inlet deficit superposition, AEP, and joint layout-yaw problem.
Use the cited AGLDPSO Eqs. (3)-(9) and Algorithm 1 for random granularity, LSH learning, and worst-particle subpopulation updates.
Retain the cited predecessor controls N=500, c1=1.0, c2=0.1, granularity interval [10,floor(sqrt(N))], 0.1N LSH buckets, and coordinate-wise random inertia.
Digitize V80 and V112 power and thrust curves from paper Fig. 5 and use eight deterministic equal-area rotor samples.
Complete absent yaw bounds as [-30,30] degrees, normalize mixed position-yaw coordinates before LSH, and use deterministic boundary and pair-spacing repair.
Use 10,000 complete-layout evaluations and 25 platform seeds because the wind paper omits stopping and repeat counts.
Implement all six paper problems; comparison methods are excluded.

paper.authors: Jeonghwan Song and Taewan Kim and Donghyun You
paper.title: Particle Swarm Optimization of a Wind Farm Layout with Active Control of Turbine Yaws

paper_linked_public_asset_candidates.use: paper-equation and algorithm audit; no executable source

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible declared reconstruction of AGLDPSO and all six paper problems; not author source, private data, random states or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: square boundary, pair spacing greater than one rotor diameter, yaw clamp, and deterministic iterative pair-spacing repair

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x-y position and one yaw angle per turbine and wind state

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: flat turbine-major real vector; positions and yaw coordinates normalized separately to [0,1] for LSH

initialization.resolution: counter-keyed feasible initialization followed by deterministic repair and complete-layout evaluation

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: best AEP, timings, physical FES, scientific hashes, and 25 independent seeds per each of six cases

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-weighted annual energy production, implemented as the equivalent reciprocal-AEP minimization ordering

paper_native_cases.resolution: WF1 at two speeds and two turbine types, WF2 larger domain, WF3 36 turbines, and WF4 uneven speed-direction probabilities

parameters.resolution: population 500, c1=1.0, c2=0.1, M in [10,floor(sqrt(N))], 0.1N buckets, yaw [-30,30] degrees, and complete-layout FES limit 10000

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: exactly 10000 complete-layout evaluations per run, including the initial 500 particles

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: not applicable; AGLDPSO updates its LSH learning rate online but has no separately trained model

update_order.resolution: random subpopulation partition, normalized LSH, update only each subpopulation worst particle, repair, evaluate, replace, and adapt granularity

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: yawed three-dimensional Gaussian wake, local-inlet linear deficit superposition, power-law shear, eight-point rotor average, digitized V80/V112 curves, and cos(gamma) yaw power factor

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: eight direction bins with equal probabilities for WF1-WF3 and paper uneven direction-speed probabilities for WF4

cited_method_predecessor.title: Adaptive Granularity Learning Distributed Particle Swarm Optimization for Large-Scale Optimization
